description: This file declares the 'AttachedSources' class, which manages a collection of media source types associated with unique identifiers within the 'firebolt::rialto::client' namespace. It provides methods to add, remove, and retrieve media sources, and uses a mutex for thread safety.

classes.name: AttachedSources
classes.description: A class that manages a thread-safe collection of media sources identified by unique IDs.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a media source with a specific ID to the collection.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the media source associated with the given ID from the collection.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the media source associated with the given ID.
